claims.text: Black Arrow OS is a pocket CRM that runs in your browser with a drag-and-drop pipeline, follow-up scheduling, and a KPI dashboard showing CPL and ROAS
Black Arrow OS is free forever, no signup, up to 25 contacts, with CSV export
Agencies resell the same category of lead-to-revenue system built on a bigger platform, marked up, while Black Arrow offers it direct
The platform includes CRM, two-way texting, booking, quiz funnels, automated missed-call text-back, review collection, win-backs, referral tracking, and revenue reporting under one login
14-day free trial with full access, no card needed, cancel anytime
Refer a business and when they subscribe, you both get a free month, tracked automatically
